title: Call Your Local AI with an API Request (Ollama curl)
description:
Call your local AI from code with one request. ⚡

✅ Ollama listens on port 11434
✅ Send a model and a prompt with curl
✅ Set stream false to get one answer back

Day 3 of Local AI Coding. Next up: Day 4, Pick a Model That Fits Your RAM.
Follow for a new short every day and build your local AI setup.

#shorts #ollama #localai #ai #aitools #coding #programming #tutorial
comment: Curl or Python: which would you use first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: leave out stream false and Ollama sends the answer back in many small pieces instead of one reply.
